name: n8n-nodes-harmony-ai
description: n8n nodes for Harmony AI voice agents: send contacts to Harmony workflows, look up contacts, calls and transcripts, and trigger flows when calls start, end, or have a recording.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && for icon in nodes/*/*.svg credentials/*.svg; do cp "$icon" "dist/$icon"; done
scripts.test: rm -rf dist/test-build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist/test-build && node --test "dist/test-build/**/*.test.js"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
